tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background — the sheet everything is written on.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, margin notes, menus, the editor canvas when it floats above paper.

tokens.name: paper-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: sidebars, code blocks, the binder behind the manuscript.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card edges. Decorative only — never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons). ≥3:1 on paper and paper-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, headings, primary-button fill. The logo's black. Reads on paper, paper-raised, paper-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: timestamps, hints, captions, word counts. ≥4.5:1 on all paper grounds in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill (primary button, Published tag).

tokens.name: marker-yellow
tokens.usage: Logo highlighter. Text highlight, selection, search hits, the Draft tag. Always under on-marker text.

tokens.name: marker-pink
tokens.usage: Logo's circling loop. 'Look here': comment threads, attention, the In-review tag. Fill or stroke; never text. Also the ground of the Highlighted band — so never use pink marks inside that band.

tokens.name: marker-blue
tokens.usage: Logo's arrow, tuned for text. Direction and action: accent button, focus ring, current location. The one marker that is text-safe: ≥4.7:1 on every ground in every theme (Paper #306abb, a shade deeper than the logo's #346fc2; Night shift #5b8fdb; Highlighted #183563, a deep navy so it holds on pink).

tokens.name: marker-green
tokens.usage: Logo's underline. Links (as the underline, never the text), insertions in tracked changes.

tokens.name: marker-orange
tokens.usage: Logo's check mark. Done, approved, accepted. Fill or check stroke; never text.

tokens.name: on-marker
tokens.usage: Text on any marker fill except blue, in both themes (8.5:1 or better on every marker).

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a marker-blue fill: white in Paper (5.4:1) and Highlighted (10:1); dark in Night shift (5.6:1).

tokens.name: blue-ink
tokens.usage: Blue as text or icon: active nav item, inline actions. On paper grounds.

tokens.name: green-ink
tokens.usage: Green as text: inserted words in tracked changes, 'saved' confirmations. On paper grounds.

tokens.name: pink-ink
tokens.usage: Pink as text: comment counts, mention names. On paper grounds.

tokens.name: orange-ink
tokens.usage: Orange as text: 'Approved' outside a tag. On paper grounds.

tokens.name: red-pen
tokens.usage: The editor's red pen — errors, deletions, blocked. Text or stroke on paper grounds. Always paired with a word or strike, never colour alone.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid with a 2px paper gap. ≥4.5:1 on every paper ground in both themes.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: ::selection background; text on it is on-marker.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero lines and covers. Always uppercase, like the logo — so never bold (Light 300 or Regular 400) and never more than 6 words / 2 lines.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Section headlines, page and manuscript titles. Caps or bold, never both: uppercase at Light/Regular (6 words max), or sentence case at up to Semibold (600).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section and panel titles. Sentence case; Semibold (600) is fine.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, overlines, tag text. Always uppercase, so 3 words max.

styles.name: prose-lg
styles.sample: It was the second draft that finally told the truth.
styles.usage: The manuscript in focus mode; marketing lede.

styles.name: prose
styles.sample: Every story starts wrong. That's the point of drafts.
styles.usage: Default body copy and the editor.

styles.name: prose-sm
styles.sample: Tighten this scene — we already know she's angry.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: Kill your darlings, but keep a copy.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Version numbers, word counts, timestamps, agent names.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tag padding-y.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls; stacked label-to-field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Tag padding-x; compact card padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button padding-x, card padding, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between form fields; gutters.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between groups within a page section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page margins around the manuscript column.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, inline highlight corners, code.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, margin notes, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and large panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status tags and collaborator swatches — the marker's round nib.

shadow.note: Paper lifts, it doesn't glow. One shadow, used sparingly.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Floating surfaces only: menus, popovers, a dragged card.

stroke.note: Line weights, from the pen to the marker.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Rules, card edges, input borders.

tokens.name: stroke-pen
tokens.usage: Focus rings, red-pen strikes, active underlines.

tokens.name: stroke-marker
tokens.usage: Marker annotations: underline, circle, check.
